title: @export_multiline does not actually use a multiline text field for dicts
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3-stable, 4.4-stable

### System information

Arch Linux 6.13.5-arch1-1

### Issue description

The [documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_%40gdscript.html#class-gdscript-annotation-export-multiline) for `@export_multiline` claims that it can be used for Dictionaries, but this doesn't seem to be the case.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e44e0bcd-544b-499c-a5fd-9cc77b51751d)

At the moment I don't have time to test, but it seems like https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/70540 should have fixed this issue. If I have time this week I'll reproduce that build and see if that implementation worked correctly.

I was also able to observe this behavior on macOS 15.1.1, so it is at least not specific to Linux.

### Steps to reproduce

- unzip project
- open in the editor
- edit a new Dictionary value (on the child Node2D, for the field Text Dict) with type `String` - should be multiline, but isn't

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[multiline.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19164644/multiline.zip)
